title: git.pp record
description: The canonical schema for a git.pp record (format v2). The five content fields plus the optional digest dialect field.

id.description: Unique identifier. Must be free of \n and : (the closure root format uses these as delimiters).

parents.description: Set of record ids this record completed against. Treated as a set; ordering carries no meaning.

kind.description: Class of the record. The fold uses this for the absolute precedence override > task > witness. Per SPEC §1.1, OTHER VALUES ARE ACCEPTED and their semantics are out of scope for the fold, so this schema does not constrain the value. It previously carried an enum of the three known kinds, which made the schema STRICTER than the spec it is supposed to describe -- a normative artifact disagreeing with the normative document.

effects.description: Map of state-key to value. Values may be number, string, boolean, array, or object. Numbers must be in the IEEE-754 float64 domain.

reason.description: Human-supplied justification. The fold does not read it; the leaf does (per CHECKPOINT-V2.md).

digest.description: Format v2 dialect field. The SHA-256 of the record's content leaf. A claim about the record; the fold never reads it. Records with a well-formed digest that disagrees with the recomputed leaf are degraded to v1 (the record passes through unchanged, the disagreement is reported). A malformed digest is ignored.

repo.description: Internal metadata. The repo that produced this copy of the record. Not part of the fold's input; surfaced for the collection layer.

orphan.description: Internal metadata. Set by the Worker if the record is excluded from the applied set due to a missing parent.

recordsBehind.description: Internal metadata. The number of applied records whose freshness this witness does not yet reflect.
